def leaky_relu_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, n, d, slope: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    offs = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)

        leaky_relu_kernel[(triton.cdiv(n, 1024),)](x, y, n, x.shape[-1], self.negative_slope, BLOCK=1024)
